extracted.intended_audience: media, journalists, and communications staff covering NHL officiating; NHL operations and scouting/development personnel
extracted.subtask_description: An official NHL media guide page listing 2023-24 on-ice officials and NHL officiating management, plus resources, contact info, pronunciation guidance, individual official statistics, and aggregate record rankings. Intended to support media coverage and official reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media resources and rule-clarification channels
rubrics_metrics.description: RESOURCES • NHL Rulebook • NHL Video Rulebook • Records.nhl.com – 2023-24 NHL Officials • For real-time rule clarifications, please follow @PR_NHL or visit NHL.com/situationroom • NHL Communications contact for NHL Officials and Officiating Staff: Jennifer Moad (jmoad@nhl.com)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists primary reference materials and the official channels for real-time clarifications and communications contact; implies media should consult the rulebook/video rulebook and the Situation Room or @PR_NHL for immediate rulings and contact Jennifer Moad for communications regarding officials.

rubrics_metrics.name: NHL officiating management/team listing
rubrics_metrics.description: Names and official titles of NHL & AHL officiating management (e.g., Executive Vice President and Director of Officiating: Stephen Walkom; Vice President of Officiating Operations: Don Van Massenhoven; Director of Video Operations: Tom Masters; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides authoritative contacts and organizational roles for understanding who manages officiating, video operations, scouting/development, fitness/training, and off-ice officials; useful for attribution and sourcing in media or operational inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: On-ice officials roster (referees & linespersons) with uniform numbers and minor-league indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: 2023-24 ON-ICE OFFICIALS — lists referees and linespersons by name with corresponding uniform numbers; '*' denotes 'Minor league team member'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authoritative roster for identifying officials on-ice by name and number and for noting which officials are assigned from minor-league teams; use the provided number and '*' indicator when referencing or identifying officials in coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pronunciation guide for officials' names
rubrics_metrics.description: PRONUNCIATION GUIDE — phonetic renderings of officials' names (examples: (BEECH, KOH-dee), (blan-DEE-nuh, BRAN-duhn), (BRAYS, RIGH-lee), etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the phonetic pronunciations to correctly speak officials' names in broadcasts, interviews, and press events; the guide gives IPA-like, all-caps phonetics and is intended for media accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-official metric: Regular Season Games (count)
rubrics_metrics.description: Regular Season Games — numeric count of regular-season games officiated by each official (presented in per-official tables).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary metric for assessing an official's regular-season experience; used individually and as input into aggregate leaderboards (e.g., 'Most Regular Season Games').

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-official metric: First Regular Season Game (date)
rubrics_metrics.description: First Regular Season Game — date of each official's first NHL regular-season game (presented in per-official tables).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates tenure/entry year into NHL regular-season officiating; useful for profiling experience and career timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-official metric: Playoff Games (count)
rubrics_metrics.description: Playoff Games — numeric count of playoff games officiated by each official (presented in per-official tables).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key metric for assessing postseason experience and prestige; often cited when describing an official's high-profile assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-official metric: First Playoff Game (date)
rubrics_metrics.description: First Playoff Game — date of each official's first NHL playoff game (presented in per-official tables).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marks the start of an official's playoff assignments and contributes to narratives about experience in high-stakes games.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Regular Season Games — All-time Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST REGULAR SEASON GAMES, ALL-TIME REFEREES — ranked list with game counts (example: Kerry Fraser 1,905; Don Koharski 1,872; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate historical leaderboard used to compare career longevity among referees; suitable for historical context and feature stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Regular Season Games — Active Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST REGULAR SEASON GAMES, ACTIVE REFEREES — ranked list of currently active referees by regular-season games (example: Kevin Pollock 1,560; Kelly Sutherland 1,455; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to highlight active officials with the most NHL regular-season experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Regular Season Games — All-time Linespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST REGULAR SEASON GAMES, ALL-TIME LINESPERSONS — ranked list with game counts (example: Ray Scapinello 2,497; Gerard Gauthier 2,339; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical leaderboard for linespersons; indicates career longevity at the linesperson position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Regular Season Games — Active Linespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST REGULAR SEASON GAMES, ACTIVE LINESPERSONS — ranked list of currently active linespersons by regular-season games (example: Brad Kovachik 1,764; Steve Barton 1,464; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify active linespersons with the most regular-season experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Playoff Games — All-time Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST PLAYOFF GAMES, ALL-TIME REFEREES — ranked list with playoff game counts (example: Bill McCreary 297; Don Koharski 266; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historic leaderboard illustrating which referees have the most postseason assignments; useful when discussing postseason officiating pedigree.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Playoff Games — Active Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST PLAYOFF GAMES, ACTIVE REFEREES — ranked list of currently active referees by playoff games (example: Kelly Sutherland 230; Kevin Pollock 219; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to highlight active referees with extensive playoff experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Playoff Games — All-time Linespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST PLAYOFF GAMES, ALL-TIME LINESPERSONS — ranked list with playoff game counts (example: Ray Scapinello 428; Brian Murphy 304; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historic leaderboard for postseason assignments among linespersons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Playoff Games — Active Linespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST PLAYOFF GAMES, ACTIVE LINESPERSONS — ranked list of currently active linespersons by playoff games (example: Brad Kovachik 200; Jonny Murray 175; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies active linespersons with the most playoff experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Stanley Cup Final (SCF) Games — All-time Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST STANLEY CUP FINAL GAMES, ALL-TIME REFEREES — ranked list with SCF game counts (example: Bill McCreary 44; Bill Chadwick 42; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures how many Stanley Cup Final games referees have officiated — a prestige metric for highest-profile assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Stanley Cup Final (SCF) Games — Active Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST STANLEY CUP FINAL GAMES, ACTIVE REFEREES — ranked list of active referees by SCF games (example: Kelly Sutherland 27; Wes McCauley 24; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify active referees with the most Stanley Cup Final on-ice appearances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Stanley Cup Final (SCF) Games — All-time Linespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST STANLEY CUP FINAL GAMES, ALL-TIME LINESPERSONS — ranked list with SCF game counts (example: George Hayes 57; Matt Pavelich 56; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historic leaderboard for linespersons' SCF game appearances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Stanley Cup Final (SCF) Games — Active Linespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST STANLEY CUP FINAL GAMES, ACTIVE LINESPERSONS — ranked list of active linespersons by SCF games (example: Jonny Murray 15; Scott Cherrey 13; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights active linespersons with SCF experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Stanley Cup Final Appearances — All-time Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST STANLEY CUP FINAL APPEARANCES, ALL-TIME REFEREES — ranked list of appearances (example: Andy van Hellemond 19; Bill McCreary 15; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts of SCF appearance seasons/occurrences for referees (used interchangeably with SCF games in historical context where appropriate).

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Stanley Cup Final Appearances — Active Referees
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST STANLEY CUP FINAL APPEARANCES, ACTIVE REFEREES — ranked list of active referees by SCF appearances (example: Kelly Sutherland 10; Wes McCauley 9; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to emphasize active referees' repeated assignment to the Cup Final.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Stanley Cup Final Appearances — All-time Linespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST STANLEY CUP FINAL APPEARANCES, ALL-TIME LINESPERSONS — ranked list of appearances (example: Matt Pavelich 21; Ray Scapinello 20; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historic measure of linespersons' repeated SCF assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Stanley Cup Final Appearances — Active Linespersons
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST STANLEY CUP FINAL APPEARANCES, ACTIVE LINESPERSONS — ranked list of active linespersons by SCF appearances (example: Jonny Murray 6; Brad Kovachik 5; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates active linespersons with multiple Cup Final appearances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most Outdoor Game Appearances — All-time
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST OUTDOOR GAME APPEARANCES, ALL-TIME — list of officials and their number of outdoor games (examples include Kelly Sutherland, Chris Rooney, Ryan Galloway, Jonny Murray; '5' appears as a top count).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts appearances in outdoor NHL events (Winter Classic, Stadium Series, Heritage Classic, NHL Outdoors at Lake Tahoe) — a specialty/high-profile assignment metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record category: Most All-Star Game Appearances — All-time
rubrics_metrics.description: MOST ALL-STAR GAME APPEARANCES, ALL-TIME — list of officials and their number of All-Star Game appearances (examples: Matt Pavelich 10; Neil Armstrong 10; George Hayes 8; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures how often an official has been selected for All-Star Game assignments — another prestige metric.
